(d) (of radio equipment, etc) for sending and receiving signals（指无线电设备等）收发两用的. (e) (of communication between people, etc) operating in both directions （指人等之间的交流）双向进行的, 有来有往的: a ,two-way `process 双向交往. For the uses of two see the examples at five. 关於two的 用法见five词条中的示例.
expansions: a two-timing rogue 欺骗对方的坏蛋
